callouts.text: Note About this analysis record This page explains how verified Visual Light Sensitivity Questionnaire (VLSQ-8) scores and personal light-exposure metrics were turned into the H08 results. Higher VLSQ-8 scores indicate greater self-reported visual light sensitivity according to the accepted scale. The companion H08 results report presents the scientific findings.

figures.alt: Bar chart of VLSQ-8 participant counts from score 13 to 39. Scores cluster around the low twenties, with fewer participants at the highest values; all 184 participants are represented.
figures.caption: Figure 1: Distribution of the verified VLSQ-8 scores. The bars sum to all 184 questionnaire participants.

figures.alt: Two line-and-point panels compare near-eye and chest support across nine ordered metrics. Solid lines with circles mark near eye; dashed lines with triangles mark chest. Participant counts are 139 to 141 near eye and 153 to 154 at the chest. Participant-day counts vary more, from 655 to 816 near eye and 743 to 902 at the chest.
figures.caption: Figure 2: Metric-specific participant and participant-day support in the primary near-eye and complementary chest analyses. Metric numbers follow the preceding table.

figures.alt: Two panels show horizontal ranges of participant-day counts for each submitted site across nine metrics. The near-eye panel has nine sites and the chest panel eight. Tübingen (DE) contributes only near-eye data; San José (CR) has the largest chest contribution.
figures.caption: Figure 3: Range of participant-day contributions by site across the nine primary near-eye and complementary chest metric frames. Site order and colours follow the submitted manuscript registry.

callouts.text: Note About this analysis record This page explains how verified Visual Light Sensitivity Questionnaire (VLSQ-8) scores and personal light-exposure metrics were turned into the H08 results. Higher VLSQ-8 scores indicate greater self-reported visual light sensitivity according to the accepted scale. The companion H08 results report presents the scientific findings.

figures.alt: Bar chart of VLSQ-8 participant counts from score 13 to 39. Scores cluster around the low twenties, with fewer participants at the highest values; all 184 participants are represented.
figures.caption: Figure 1: Distribution of the verified VLSQ-8 scores. The bars sum to all 184 questionnaire participants.

figures.alt: Two line-and-point panels compare near-eye and chest support across nine ordered metrics. Solid lines with circles mark near eye; dashed lines with triangles mark chest. Participant counts are 139 to 141 near eye and 153 to 154 at the chest. Participant-day counts vary more, from 655 to 816 near eye and 743 to 902 at the chest.
figures.caption: Figure 2: Metric-specific participant and participant-day support in the primary near-eye and complementary chest analyses. Metric numbers follow the preceding table.

figures.alt: Two panels show horizontal ranges of participant-day counts for each submitted site across nine metrics. The near-eye panel has nine sites and the chest panel eight. Tübingen (DE) contributes only near-eye data; San José (CR) has the largest chest contribution.
figures.caption: Figure 3: Range of participant-day contributions by site across the nine primary near-eye and complementary chest metric frames. Site order and colours follow the submitted manuscript registry.
